pages.title: Hook A Brainrot
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Cast your hook into the field in Hook A Brainrot and pull a random character out of the ground. A tsunami follows the catch, so drag it into the Safe Zone before the wave reaches it. Take the Brainrot back to your base to add it to your collection and earn money over time.

pages.title: The Three Tiles in the Halloween World
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Find groups of three matching Halloween tiles in The Three Tiles in the Halloween World. Check which tiles are available before you pick them and look for a set you can finish. Work through the layouts by opening up more of the board with each match.

pages.title: Cut the Nut
pages.creator: YO-YOgames
pages.description: Get a nut to a waiting squirrel in Cut the Nut. Cut the ropes in the right order and use objects in the scene to bounce the nut toward its mouth. Think about where the nut will swing or fall before you make the next cut.

pages.title: Find Hidden Secrets
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Search scenes for hidden items in Find Hidden Secrets. Look carefully before clicking, since mistakes slow you down. When an object is hard to spot, use one of the two power-ups to help finish the level.

pages.title: Island Expander
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Start on a tiny island in Island Expander and gather resources to craft what you need. Discover more than 30 recipes, from simple tools to machines, as you develop the island. Decide what to make next based on the materials you have and the parts you still want to build.

pages.title: Twinkle Shooter
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Fire stones at matching colors in Twinkle Shooter. Groups of three or more clear, and a falling stone that enters the heart spins the slot for a chance at Fever. Keep clearing groups before the stones reach the bottom and end the round.

pages.title: Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Rebuild pictures piece by piece in Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles. Use recognizable shapes and colors to work out which pieces belong together. Start with a detail you can identify, then use it to place the pieces around it as the picture comes into view.

pages.title: Summon Tribe
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a defense in Summon Tribe by merging identical units into stronger ones. Work out which units to combine before enemies reach your line, then keep strengthening the tribe as the defense continues. The game also supports idle play.

pages.title: Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pick anything from a sports car to a monster truck in Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes. Drive into obstacles and see how each vehicle responds to the impact. Switch cars when you want to try a different handling style for the next crash.

pages.title: Dream Pet Hotel
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Match tiles in Dream Pet Hotel to earn rewards for your hotel. Unlock rooms, then furnish and decorate them for the pets that will stay there. Work between the puzzles and the hotel as your collection grows to include animals such as cats, dogs, and pandas.

pages.title: Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Release the wooden plates in Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve by taking out the fasteners that hold them up. Check where each plate is pinned before tapping a bolt, since freeing one piece can change which fasteners you can reach. Keep going until every plate falls.

pages.title: World Solitaire -Tripeaks-
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Clear the peaks in World Solitaire -Tripeaks- by taking cards one rank above or below the current card. Look at what a move will uncover before you choose it. Draw from the stock when the exposed cards offer no useful move, then see how far you can go.

pages.title: Beach Club
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Run a stretch of beach in Beach Club. Collect money from customers, hire help, and add seats so more people can visit. Keep clean towels available and spend your earnings on new amenities as you expand along the shore.

pages.title: Word Rush
pages.creator: Flecks Labs
pages.description: Build words from letter cards in Word Rush. Making a word removes its cards and opens up more choices, while drawing from the deck can give you a letter you need. Look for a combination that scores well and leaves useful letters for the next word.

pages.title: Bomby
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Pull back the slingshot and launch a bird in Bomby. Change the angle and strength to get around obstacles or hit the blocks from a different side. Watch how the pieces move after impact before lining up the next shot.

pages.title: Murder
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Wait for a chance to strike the king in Murder. Pick the moment to act as the king moves through the Halloween setting. If the attempt succeeds, you take the crown and play as the king yourself.

pages.title: Drill Quest
pages.creator: PLEXYGAME
pages.description: Break blocks with a drill in Drill Quest and put what you gather toward building a city. Explore different locations and upgrade your equipment as you go. Try different machines when you want to change how you work through the blocks.

pages.title: College Girl Coloring Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Dress and color a character in College Girl Coloring Dress Up. Choose a hairstyle, clothes, and accessories, then select a color and click the section you want to fill. Give the outfit its own palette as you put together the character's look.

pages.title: Touchdown Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run downfield in Touchdown Master while dodging defenders and obstacles. Steer toward coins and keys when there is an opening. At the end of the run, throw the football as far as you can to earn extra gold.

pages.title: Wired Chicken Inc
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Start a farm with a single duck egg in Wired Chicken Inc. Hatch the egg, let the duckling produce another one, and keep the cycle going. Watch what each round of hatching adds to the farm as you build it up from the first bird.

pages.title: Super Soccer Noggins - Xmas Edition
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Take a big-headed football player onto a snowy pitch in Super Soccer Noggins - Xmas Edition. Move with the cursor keys and use Space as you challenge the other side for the ball. Choose a player in Christmas gear and aim to score more goals than your opponent.

pages.title: Templok
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Fit groups of three block pieces into an underwater grid in Templok. Fill a row or column to clear it and earn points, or clear several lines together for a combo. Look at the space a piece will leave before placing it.

pages.title: Daily Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Play Klondike in Daily Solitaire and build a foundation for each suit from ace to king. Move cards between columns to expose the ones underneath and use the stock when you need new options. Keep going until all four suits are complete.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Mayhem
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Clear the city of Skibidi Toilets across ten levels in Skibidi Toilet Mayhem. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, then aim and fire with the mouse. Use the scroll wheel to change weapons when a different one suits the targets ahead.

pages.title: SLING & SHOOT!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Pull back a slingshot in SLING & SHOOT! and fire at the targets beyond the obstacles. Change your angle if something blocks a direct shot. Pick up coins as you go and save them for new slingshots or ammunition.

pages.title: Jelly Merger
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Combine matching jellies in Jelly Merger to create upgraded versions that earn more. Use those earnings to build up your collection, then look for the next pair you can merge. Keep improving the setup as it brings in idle income.

pages.title: Daily Jigsaw
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Assemble a new picture in Daily Jigsaw by dragging pieces onto the board. The subjects range from animals and landscapes to landmarks and abstract designs. Start with a recognizable part of the image and use its edges to connect the pieces around it.

pages.title: Pop Jewels
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Clear matching jewels in Pop Jewels. Find a group of three or more in the same color and remove it to make space on the board. Keep looking for the next group as the layout changes and see how high a score you can reach.

pages.title: Imposter Expansion Wars
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Send troops from your blue towers to take over enemy towers in Imposter Expansion Wars. Read the numbers before deciding where to send a force. Keep moving troops between targets until you have taken every opposing tower.

pages.title: Bike Racing Bike Stunt Games
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Take a motorcycle onto stunt tracks in Bike Racing Bike Stunt Games. Accelerate toward ramps, use nitro when you have room, and change the camera if you want another view of the approach. Try different bikes and keep an eye on rivals while lining up a stunt.

pages.title: Draw the coffee
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Draw a line to guide the coffee past obstacles in Draw the coffee. Use a swipe to give the liquid a path toward the cup, then see where it flows. Change the shape of the line when a barrier makes the direct route unusable.

pages.title: Soul Hunter
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Help a skull reach its lost love in Soul Hunter. Take over the souls of people or creatures and use them to carry out tasks that get the skull farther. Think about which soul you need before moving into the next part of a puzzle.

pages.title: Heroball Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide the red ball past obstacles in Heroball Run. Move left or right to line up with an opening, jump over low hazards, and slide when you need to get underneath. Watch the path ahead so you have time to choose the next move.

pages.title: Airplane Missile Escape
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Fly a warplane over the sea in Airplane Missile Escape. Get used to steering before the rockets begin chasing you, then turn away from their paths as they close in. Use the arrow keys or WASD and see how long you can keep the plane in the air.

pages.title: Steam Droid
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Free captive droids across 14 levels in Steam Droid. Fight on foot or ride mine carts and floating barrels as the route takes you through mines, a foundry, and hillsides. Break crates for pickups such as rockets or extra health before you face the mine owner.

pages.title: War Of Tanks Paper Note
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Drive a tank across a paper battlefield in War Of Tanks Paper Note. In solo mode, destroy five targets per stage and stay clear of the lasers until you have dealt with the targets blocking the way. Check the map for the next destination, or pick two-player mode to challenge a friend.

pages.title: Noob Vs 1000 Zombies!
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Help Noob find and rescue a sheep in Noob Vs 1000 Zombies! Use a short bow to shoot zombies, work around traps, and explore a secret mine. Follow the story through the burning forest and the trials that stand between Noob and the sheep.

pages.title: Winter Vacation
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Trace chains of identical winter objects in Winter Vacation. Start with one item and move through matching neighbors to clear them. Watch the goals at the bottom of the board, since completing them gives you extra moves to continue.

pages.title: Kingdom defense online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Defend your castle as a magic king in Kingdom defense online. Use spells and weapons against incoming enemies, and spend the money you collect on improvements and power-ups. Build up your defenses before the final boss reaches the castle.

pages.title: The Aviator
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Fly past red meteorites in The Aviator. Drag to steer toward blue crystals when you have a clear route. The crystals refill your energy and can also help upgrade the aircraft, so pick them up while you work toward the end of the flight.

pages.title: Farming 10x10
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Plant crop shapes in a ten-by-ten field in Farming 10x10. Fill a row or column to harvest what grows there and free more space for planting. Keep the rows coming until the truck is full and ready to take the harvest to market.

pages.title: Blob Giant 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect jellies of your own color in Blob Giant 3D to grow before the finish. Steer toward matching blobs and build up enough energy for the jump onto the inflatable cushion. The bounce sends your teammates into the air to try to reach a treasure chest.

pages.title: Candy Connect New
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Pair identical candy tiles in Candy Connect New before time runs out. A connection can use up to three straight segments and cannot pass through other tiles. Choose a board size and use a hint or shuffle when the remaining matches are hard to reach.

pages.title: Tiny Fishing
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Set your cast with the spinner in Tiny Fishing, then drag the hook from side to side as it rises. Each fish brings in cash when the line reaches the surface. Spend the money between casts on upgrades and hooks that help you catch more.

pages.title: Sea Rush
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear groups of matching blocks in Sea Rush to rescue fish trapped in bubbles. Each level asks you to free three fish. Use power-ups to clear more of the board, or collect three rainbow blocks to get a random power-up.

pages.title: Ball Drop 3D
pages.creator: GamePop
pages.description: Steer a speeding ball along the track in Ball Drop 3D. Drag left or right to keep it over the course as it goes airborne. Higher flights add to your score, so balance the height you want with the landing you can make.

pages.title: Cool Cars Jigsaw Puzzle 2
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Put together eight car pictures in Cool Cars Jigsaw Puzzle 2. Drag each piece into its place and choose a two-by-three, three-by-four, or four-by-six grid. Use the cars' outlines and background details to work out where pieces join.

pages.title: Yatzy
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Roll dice and build scoring combinations in Yatzy. Choose which dice to keep and which to roll again, then decide where the result fits on your scorecard. Balance the combinations you can score now against the ones you still want to try for.

pages.title: Sweet Donut Maker Bakery
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Shop for ingredients in Sweet Donut Maker Bakery and take them to the kitchen. Prepare the dough, fry the donuts, and decorate them before serving. Use the baking tools at each step as you work through the recipe and fill orders.

pages.title: Jungle Hidden Numeric
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Search a jungle scene for hidden numbers in Jungle Hidden Numeric. Scan the image and click each number when you spot it. Check areas where shapes or colors make digits blend in as you work toward finding them all.

pages.title: Parking Car
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Draw a route for the car in Parking Car. The car follows the line you make, so use it to steer around anything in the way and guide the vehicle into the parking space. Finish the route in the bay to pass the checkpoint.

pages.title: Animals Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Link pairs of identical animal tiles in Animals Mahjong Connection. Look for matches that have room for a connecting path and remove them to open the board. Keep working through the animal pairs until every tile is gone.

pages.title: Num Cannons
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Solve the math problem in Num Cannons and select the cannon showing the correct answer. The right choice fires a shot that pops the balloons. Check your calculation before choosing a cannon as you move through the questions.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Easter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Launch Easter eggs into matching groups in Bubble Shooter Easter. Aim where an egg can join others like it and clear space on the board. Use the available power-ups when the layout makes a target group harder to reach.

pages.title: Corona Conqueror
pages.creator: Radical Play LLC
pages.description: Fire rolls of toilet paper at the incoming virus in Corona Conqueror. Aim upward and keep the shots coming to stop the virus before it reaches you. Watch its position as you fire and see how long you can hold it back.

pages.title: Transportation Vehicles Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over tiles to find matching vehicles in Transportation Vehicles Memory. Remember what was under each tile when a pair does not match, then use that information on later turns. Clear the pairs across four levels and aim to use fewer moves.

pages.title: The Fish Master
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drop a line in The Fish Master and catch as many fish as you can. Use what you earn to improve the line so it reaches deeper and can bring back a bigger catch. Try another cast when an upgrade opens more of the water.

pages.title: Golf Adventure
pages.creator: Kevin_Alf Desing
pages.description: Get the golf ball to the hole in Golf Adventure with only a limited number of shots. Judge how much power you need to get over mountains, boxes, or buildings. Pick a landing spot that leaves you an easier shot if the hole is out of reach.

pages.title: Stack Ball
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Bring a ball down a helix tower in Stack Ball. Wait for a safe section before sending the ball through the platforms and stay clear of black tiles. Check what is beneath the current layer so you can time the next drop.

pages.title: The Rings Puzzle
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Place colored rings in The Rings Puzzle and line up the same color across a row, column, or diagonal. Look at the colors already on the board before choosing where to put the next piece. Try to leave room for another line as you build each match.

pages.title: Space Fighter
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Pilot a spaceship through enemy formations in Space Fighter. Shoot the ships you encounter and use a boost when you need speed to pursue a target. Keep watching how the other fighters move as you fly through the battle.

pages.title: Neon snake
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Guide a neon worm left and right in Neon snake and attack enemies as you try to survive. Use the arrow keys or the corresponding side of the touch screen to steer. Watch the enemies' shots and change direction when your current route puts you in their path.

pages.title: Illustration Love Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six love-themed illustrations in Illustration Love Puzzle. Choose a picture and solve it with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Follow the colors and shapes along each edge to work out where the pieces meet.

pages.title: Baby Dolls Surprise Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Open surprise eggs and style the dolls in Baby Dolls Surprise Dress Up. Try makeup and clothes on the doll you reveal and see how the pieces work together. Switch up the look when you want to try another combination.

pages.title: Cute Mermaid Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Put together an underwater look in Cute Mermaid Dress Up. Choose a hairstyle and a swimsuit, then pair them with a fish tail that fits the style. Try different combinations to change how the mermaid looks from head to fin.

pages.title: Xmas Explorer
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Trace a chain of three or more identical holiday items in Xmas Explorer. Connect neighbors horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, then release to merge them into a new item. Keep discovering what each merge makes as you work toward the final Christmas item.

pages.title: Air War Plane Flight Simulator Challenge 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Fly a C130 through mountain terrain in Air War Plane Flight Simulator Challenge 3D. Follow the mission route and keep the aircraft under control as the terrain changes. Complete the flight tasks to collect points before taking on another mission.

pages.title: Head Sports Football
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Set up a match in Head Sports Football by choosing your player, field, weather, and difficulty. Move and jump with the arrow keys and use Z to kick. Try to get the ball past your opponent more often than they get it past you.

pages.title: Pop Autumn Fashion
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Go shopping for fall clothes in Pop Autumn Fashion. Help the model put together an outfit and give her a makeover to match. Browse the seasonal choices and try different pieces before deciding on the finished look.

pages.title: Halloween Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Arrange falling mask blocks in Halloween Tetriz. Move the shapes left or right and rotate them to fit into the gaps. Build a full row to clear it and make room for the next blocks, using the arrow keys or on-screen buttons.

pages.title: Basket IO
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Jump and release to shoot in Basket IO. Watch the distance to the hoop while your player is airborne and time the release so the ball goes through. Keep scoring to compete for first place and see the fire effect as your score rises.

pages.title: Bootle Target Shooting 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Aim at bottles and break them in Bootle Target Shooting 3D. Look for a clear shot before firing, then move your aim to the next target. Try the different environments and use bullets or stones to smash the glass.

pages.title: Emoji Sliding Down
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide an emoji down a course in Emoji Sliding Down. Use the mouse to adjust its movement and keep it clear of obstacles as the course scrolls. See how high a score you can earn and unlock different emojis as you play.

pages.title: Solitaire Master
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Build suit foundations from ace to king in Solitaire Master. Arrange the tableau in descending order with alternating colors to uncover hidden cards. Use the stock when the board offers no useful move and see how high you can take your score.

pages.title: Cut It 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Divide each shape into two equal areas in Cut It 2. Draw your cut where you think the two halves will balance, then check the result. More even cuts earn more stars, so adjust the angle or position when one slice comes out larger.

pages.title: Funny Easter Girls
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Mia, Emma, and Ella get ready for Easter in Funny Easter Girls. Choose makeup and outfits for the three friends, then decorate their eggs. Use a different palette for each look or tie the party together with matching colors.

pages.title: Pig Escape
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Help the pig reach the gate in Pig Escape. Use the mouse to work through each layout and look for a route around the obstacles. Check what is between the pig and the gate before you make your next move.

pages.title: Craft Tetris
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Rotate falling pieces and fit them into rows in Craft Tetris. A full row disappears and gives you more room to stack the next shape. Keep the board open by filling gaps before the blocks pile up too high.

pages.title: Space Ripper
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Survive enemy attacks in Space Ripper. Your ship has little health, so watch where enemies are moving and make room to shoot back. A run has no saves, and the game challenges you to stay alive for five minutes.

pages.title: Break the Cup
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Drop balls to tip over glasses in Break the Cup. Choose where each ball should fall so it can knock a glass over and spill its contents. If the glass stays upright, try a different point of impact on the next attempt.

pages.title: Pet Hop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hop through traffic in Pet Hop. Tap to move forward and swipe to change lanes when a vehicle blocks the way. The terrain keeps changing, and coins from your runs can unlock other pets such as a panda, tiger, or chicken.

pages.title: Blind Shot
pages.creator: Joshua Hall
pages.description: Memorize where the targets appear in Blind Shot. When the screen goes dark, fire at the positions you remember. Use the space between targets as a reference while they are visible so you can place your shots once they disappear.

pages.title: Find Differences Bunny
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Compare two pictures in Find Differences Bunny and look for five details that change between them. Scan the same part of both images before choosing a spot. Find every difference to see all the surprises in the scene.

pages.title: Sheep Party
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Play as a sheep in Sheep Party and watch the wolf's muzzle swing toward you. Jump to let it pass or time a block to send it back the other way. Share the screen with up to three other players and watch when someone changes its direction.

pages.title: Amazing Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Play Klondike on a random deal in Amazing Klondike Solitaire. Build each suit from ace to king while moving cards through alternating colors on the board. Choose from three difficulty levels or change the draw mode to vary how you work through the deck.

pages.title: Flowers Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Join matching flowers in Flowers Game by drawing paths between them. Fit the paths around one another while covering every square on the board. Check how much room a line leaves for the remaining flowers before drawing it.

pages.title: Fruit Crush Frenzy
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Trace a path through matching fruit in Fruit Crush Frenzy to pop the group. Use bombs and rainbow bonuses to clear more of the board, then look for the next chain. Keep making matches to add points before time runs out.

pages.title: Moto Xtreme CS
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ride across a construction site in Moto Xtreme CS. Use the accelerator and brake to get over obstacles and land your jumps. Work through 40 levels, earn reputation, and unlock more motorcycles as you take on the harder courses.

pages.title: Solitaire 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Stack cards from ace to king in Solitaire 3. Use the mouse to move the cards and check what each move will uncover. When the layout has no useful card available, draw from the deck and look for another way to continue.

pages.title: Kris Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Find matching tiles and connect them in Kris Mahjong. Look for an open route between two identical pictures, then clear the pair so it leaves room for later connections. Keep working through the layout until the board is empty.

pages.title: Glamour Prom Night
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Style three girls for a special night in Glamour Prom Night. Pick a dress for each one, then choose a hairstyle, shoes, and a purse that fit. Try different colors and textures to give each outfit its own look.

pages.title: Ice Princess Mall Shopping
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Put together a look at the mall in Ice Princess Mall Shopping. Browse clothes and accessories with a personal shopper, then take your outfit to the catwalk. Enter style contests and vote for a favorite look as you try sporty, classy, or urban outfits.

pages.title: Strawberry Delicious Boutique!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Strawberry prepare desserts in Strawberry Delicious Boutique! Choose an ice cream flavor, then pick sweets to decorate a cake. Work on a cupcake as well and try different decorations for each of the treats in her new shop.
